keywords: science, technology and society 2.media technology and social change 3.communication theory 4.contents production and literacy 5.community cooperation
educationalGoal: The course focuses on the linkage between communication technology and society. It deals with the science and technology. It aims to improve basic academic skills and organically connect them with specialized fields based on the Academic Foundation Programs. Students will acquire innovative knowledge on the diffusion of science and technology to equip with active information transmission processes. It also develops literacy skills through group discussions and individual content creation, which can be applied to later studies in specialized fields.
advice: This class aims to the relationship between science and technology and society, overlapping with various contemporary issues by following points; (1) To understand the evolution and development of media technology and social changes; (2) To expand knowledge by relating the evolution and development of media technology and social changes that people have been consciously and unconsciously involved in their daily lives; (3) To analyze the information and communication environment of a globalized society theoretically;(4) To understand and consider the relationship between communication theory and technology and society through class and group discussions; (5) To understand media theory and acquire literacy skills by creating content to experience the relationship between science and technology and society as an individual; and (6) To learn the relationship between science, technology, and society in the context of regional cooperation and reevaluate it concerning oneself * The class also focuses on the latest science and technology in the Hokuriku area. Students should be aware that science and technology are not generated in one aspect of time based on their daily social experiences but are innovations that extend the continuity of history.
books: [reference books] Communication Models - For the Study of Mass Communication [Rountledge] メディア用語基本辞典(Encyclopedia of Media & Communication Studies) [Sekai Shiso-sha] 社会は情報化の夢を見る(Society dreams of Informatization - John von Neumann's Dream related to the Desire of Modernity) [Kawade Shobo Shinsha]
requiredKnowledge: This course aims to enable students to deal with issues from a more diverse perspective and develop the ability to think independently about the state and position of Japan (as a people) by tracking science and technology and changes in the international community. Therefore, in addition to science and technology, students should pay attention to daily news from media channels that they have access to and be interested in the relationship between Japan and other countries in the international society and issues that need to be resolved internationally.

activityGoals.body: to be able to think about STS from one's point of view as liberal arts knowledge
to understand and explain how science and technology have developed in the context of human history
to understand and discuss the case of digitalization that has revolutionized broadcasting
to experience the characteristics of electronic media by creating digital voice content with narration
to write a research paper on STS based on academic literature, including English written articles
to be able to think about the nature of regional cooperation by self-assessing the STS learning related to SDGs

achievementLevels.ideal: ・Comprehensively understand the relationship in STS and logically and critically analyze stakeholder relationships. ・Understand the mathematical model of information transmission and the human communication model precisely describe their views in academic expression. ・To comprehensively understand the characteristics of information transmission channels related to communication technology and to be able to produce contents. ・To be able to self-assess the relationship between this course and the university's educational goals and apply it to their future career development.
achievementLevels.standard: ・Generally understand the relationship in STS and illustrate the analysis of stakeholder relationships. ・Understand the mathematical model of information transmission and the human communication model moderately describe their views in academic expression. ・To understand the characteristics of information transmission channels related to communication technology and to be able to produce content. ・To be able to self-assess the relationship between this course and its educational goals and apply it to their daily study practice, somewhat looking for future career development.
